applied.quote: The [Restore Online Shoppers' Confidence Act (ROSCA)](https://www.govinfo.gov/link/uscode/15/8403) still applies to covered internet transactions with a negative-option feature, such as an auto-renewal.
applied.replacement: The [Restore Online Shoppers' Confidence Act (ROSCA)](https://www.govinfo.gov/link/uscode/15/8403) still applies to covered internet transactions with a negative-option feature.
applied.why: SOURCE does not give auto-renewal as an example of ROSCA's negative-option feature.

applied.quote: For communications-service problems within its scope, you can file with the [Federal Communications Commission (FCC)](https://consumercomplaints.fcc.gov/hc/en-us), and its jurisdiction varies by issue.
applied.replacement: For communications-service problems within its scope, you can file with the [Federal Communications Commission (FCC)](https://consumercomplaints.fcc.gov/hc/en-us), and its jurisdiction varies.
applied.why: SOURCE says only that jurisdiction varies, not that it varies by issue.

applied.quote: A dated written request sent through the biller's listed route gives you a record to show the biller or a regulator later.
applied.why: SOURCE does not state this consequence of a written request.

applied.quote: Your first statement after the effective date shows whether billing stopped.
applied.why: SOURCE does not make this claim about statements.
